rules.action: Design, manufacture, test and deliver EDU Unit and Additional Payloads
rules.description: Orbital shall design, manufacture, test and deliver one (1) payload (without antenna) engineering development unit (the 'EDU Unit') and six (6) additional Automatic Identification System (AIS) Signal payloads (the 'Additional Payloads') in accordance with the Statement of Work and Specifications attached hereto, including (without limitation) the delivery schedule set forth in Section 2.1.1 of the SOW (the 'Delivery Schedule').

triggers.condition: Effective Date established (both parties signed AND first Milestone Payment received)

effects.description: Delivery of EDU Unit and six Additional Payloads per Delivery Schedule

constraints.description: Grace period for Additional Payloads (less antenna subsystem) - no penalty during this period
Grace period for antenna subsystem - no penalty during this period

rules.action: Provide all associated deliverables without additional charge
rules.description: Orbital acknowledges and agrees that it shall provide all associated deliverables, including the EDU Unit, documentation, and services, as specified in the Procurement Agreement, this Amendment, and the SOW without additional charge, except if and to the extent that a particular task is expressly stated as being subject to additional payment for time and material expenses.

triggers.condition: Throughout performance of contract

effects.description: Provision of deliverables, documentation, and services

rules.action: Pay firm fixed price for Additional Payloads
rules.description: The firm fixed price for the six (6) Additional Payloads, each with an additional SRX, shall total $17,000,000 (the 'Price'), which ORBCOMM shall pay Orbital, in accordance with Exhibit E-1 of this Amendment.

triggers.condition: Completion of AP Milestones as described in Section 5.3 of Procurement Agreement

effects.description: Payment of milestone amounts per Exhibit E-1

constraints.description: Payments due net 10 days for payments defined in Exhibit E-1

rules.action: Pay liquidated delay damages for late delivery
rules.description: If one or more of the Additional Payloads is not delivered in accordance with the requirements of this Amendment within fourteen (14) months of the Effective Date plus sixty (60) days grace period (no penalty shall be incurred in the grace period) for the Additional Payloads (less the antenna subsystem) and fourteen (14) months plus ninety (90) days grace period for the antenna subsystem associated therewith, starting on the first day after such applicable grace period has been exhausted, Orbital shall pay ORBCOMM liquidated delay damages of 0.05% ($8,500) per day for each Additional Payload that has not been so delivered for each day of delay.

triggers.condition: Delivery not made within 14 months plus applicable grace period after Effective Date
triggers.duration: 14 months plus 60 days for payloads, 14 months plus 90 days for antenna

effects.description: Liquidated delay damages payment

constraints.description: Total late delivery damages capped at 15% of Price ($2,550,000)
Daily late delivery damages capped at $25,000 per day
Late charges determined by greatest lateness of any single item associated with same Additional Payload, not additive for separate items
Late delivery damages inclusive of power and weight penalties described in clause 3.(iv)

rules.action: Pay on-time delivery incentive
rules.description: If the EDU Unit and all of the Additional Payloads are delivered in accordance with the requirements of this Amendment by the date specified in the Delivery Schedule, ORBCOMM shall pay Orbital a single on-time delivery incentive of 1.2% of the Price ($204,000).

triggers.condition: EDU Unit and all Additional Payloads delivered by Delivery Schedule date

effects.description: Single on-time delivery incentive payment

rules.action: Pay early delivery incentive
rules.description: If all of the Additional Payloads are so delivered on time, for each day that the Additional Payloads are so delivered early, ORBCOMM shall pay Orbital 0.01% of Price ($1700) per day of early delivery.

triggers.condition: All Additional Payloads delivered early (before Delivery Schedule date)

effects.description: Early delivery incentive payment

constraints.description: Total early delivery incentive capped at $100,000 for all Additional Payloads combined
For early delivery calculation, least early item associated with particular Additional Payload controls

rules.action: Pay power and weight penalties
rules.description: If ORBCOMM agrees to accept Additional Payloads that exceed the maximum operating power and/or weight limits set forth in the Specifications, then Orbital shall pay ORBCOMM as compensation therefor, $10,000 per Kg in excess of 20.31 Kg (inclusive of 1kg grace) for the total Additional Payload mass as set forth in Section 4.5.4 of the Specifications and $10,000 per 5 Watts in excess of 120 Watts (inclusive of 5 Watts margin) of total Additional Payload power as set forth in Section 4.5.5 of the Specifications, in each case per Additional Payload, and in each case pro rated for partial amounts in excess of such maximum weight and/or power.

triggers.condition: Additional Payload exceeds weight limit
Additional Payload exceeds power limit

effects.description: Weight penalty payment
Power penalty payment

constraints.description: Combined power and/or weight penalties capped at $100,000
Penalties pro-rated for partial amounts in excess of limits

rules.action: Deliver performance bond or letter of credit
rules.description: In order to holdback such amounts, ORBCOMM shall, not later than thirty (30) days prior to launch, deliver to ORBITAL a performance bond or letter of credit to receive such payment, failing which ORBCOMM shall make the Holdback Payment to Orbital or a mutually agreeable third party escrow agent at that time.

triggers.condition: 30 days prior to launch

effects.description: Delivery of performance bond or letter of credit

rules.action: Make Holdback Payment if bond/LOC not delivered
rules.description: If ORBCOMM fails to deliver bond/letter of credit, ORBCOMM shall make the Holdback Payment to Orbital or a mutually agreeable third party escrow agent at that time, but subject to refund by Orbital (or release to ORBCOMM by such escrow agent), on a pro rata basis, if one or more of the Additional Payloads are not so successfully operating on said first anniversary date.

triggers.condition: ORBCOMM fails to deliver performance bond or letter of credit by 30 days prior to launch

effects.description: Holdback Payment to Orbital or escrow agent

constraints.description: Subject to pro rata refund if one or more Additional Payloads not successfully operating on first anniversary date
